ORDINANCE XV OF 1979
ORDINANCE XV OF 1979
ISLAMABAD CLUB
(ADMINISTRATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1975
An Ordinance to amend the
Islamabad Club (Administration) Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 1st March 1979]
No. F. 17(1)/79-Pub.-The following Ordinance made by
the President is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Islamabad Club (Administration) (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 6, Ordinance XXXIII of 1978

2. Amendment of section 6,
Ordinance XXXIII of 1978.-In
the Islamabad Club (Administration) Ordinance, 1978 (XXXIII of 1978), in
section 6, for the words "six months" the words "one year"
shall be substituted.
